eyebrow: Where it actually lives on disk
code:
~/.aws/credentials
[default]
aws_access_key_id = AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
aws_secret_access_key = wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY

~/.aws/config
[default]
region = us-east-1
output = json
caption: aws configure just writes these two plain-text files for you.
